description: This Java interface defines the contract for patient identifier validators within the OpenMRS system. It specifies methods for getting the validator name, validating identifiers, generating valid identifiers, and retrieving allowed characters.

classes.name: IdentifierValidator
classes.description: Interface for patient identifier validators, providing methods to validate, generate, and retrieve information about patient identifiers.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this validator, e.g., 'Luhn Algorithm'.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks whether a given identifier is valid according to this validator. Throws UnallowedIdentifierException for invalid or disallowed identifiers.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a validated identifier with check digits or other validation measures applied. Throws UnallowedIdentifierException if input is invalid.

methods.name: getAllowedCharacters
methods.description: Returns a string of all characters permitted in identifiers validated by this validator.
